import unittest
from conftest import trace


class SubtestTransitions(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_subtest_skip_only(self):
        with self.subTest(value="skip"):
            self.skipTest("only-subtest-skip")
        trace("after-only-subtest-skip")

    def test_parent_skip_after_failure(self):
        with self.subTest(value="failure"):
            self.fail("child-failure-before-parent-skip")
        self.skipTest("parent-skip-after-child-failure")

    def test_nested(self):
        with self.subTest("outer", outer=1):
            with self.subTest("inner", inner=2):
                self.fail("nested-subtest-failure")
            trace("after-nested-failure")
